## Description

High-temperature fiberglass filter media rated for continuous 300 °C (350 °C peak), catalogued in the filter-media category with a G3/G4 grade. The source publishes 85/95% efficiency figures, airflow of 5800/5400 m³/h and dust-holding of 500/600 g/m². Fiberglass suits high-temperature industrial exhaust and process duty where synthetic media would fail. From a sourcing perspective, buyers should verify the exact continuous temperature requirement and specify the grade. Request an efficiency curve and verify roll width and grammage before committing volume.
